located_observations.location: upper left eyebrow, two-line Title and Latin companion
located_observations.observation: Plum serif Title has substantial body and stroke contrast, stable syllable proportions and open counters. Market eyebrow is immediately above and quieter Latin is immediately below. No other line competes in scale.

Secondary semibold subtitle leads into one medium sans five-line paragraph with consistent start and meaningful wraps. All words are readable; punctuation sits at line ends without isolated syllables.

located_observations.location: right route from paragraph end to date and final URL
located_observations.observation: A group gap separates explanation from date without moving the reader to another column. Hours, venue, access, care, invitation and URL continue on the same nearby start. Visit lines remain readable.

located_observations.location: high middle rubber-like plant; branching middle pot; broad lower-left calathea-like canopy; lower-middle smaller pot
located_observations.observation: Visible unequal ochre rims, dark soil, connected stems and asymmetrical foliage form a continuous overhead gathering at different living scales. Broad lower-left plant has visible rim crescent, soil and stems. Its leaves crop at left/bottom. Pot and foliage shadows remain attached to the shared painted surface.

located_observations.location: leaf surfaces, ochre ceramic rims and creamy support
located_observations.observation: Opaque gouache strokes have controlled dry edges, selective leaf veins, layered greens and plum leaf reverses. Directional shadows agree with selective window light. Typography remains flat and precise over light clearances.

Large two-line left Title and the connected central/lower-left planted masses form the main anchors. Right prose/practical route remains one visible column. The plant gathering shapes the large spatial organization rather than appearing as a tiny attachment or independent image strip.

style.checked_requirement: Assigned overhead expressive gouache planted-pot gathering; dominant two-line left serif Korean Title; right five-line prose descends locally into schedule and actions.

substantive_visual.concept: Comparing and tending houseplants represented through differently scaled living canopies, soil, planted stems, visible pot rims and coherent window light.

hangul.observations: Title counters and controlled stroke contrast remain open; reading sans has consistent baselines, syllable proportions and medium strokes. Word spaces are visible, including body line boundaries. No observed definite missing or invented Hangul.

information_relationship.observations: Eyebrow identifies market purpose next to Title; central pot rhythm bridges left identity to right promise. Paragraph directly leads to practical dates, hours, venue and participation. Invitation and URL remain adjacent to that route.
